fields.description: Save header word 0 (low word of EEPROM block 0). Copied from ROM defaults into the RAM save mirror by FUN_08021c74; baseline value 2934 (0x0B76). No runtime writer was found in decomp, so exact gameplay meaning is undetermined.
fields.evidence: FUN_08021c74 copies 8 ROM-default bytes into save-mirror block 0; logical offset 0 matches baseline low word 0x00000B76 under eeprom_rev8.
fields.name: header_word0

fields.description: Save header word 1 (high word of EEPROM block 0). Copied from ROM defaults by FUN_08021c74; baseline 0x3DAF00FC. Tested against sum/xor/crc32 over all save regions in both raw and logical domains and it verifies as no supported checksum, so it is mapped as data, not a checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_08021c74 seeds save-mirror block 0 from ROM data; checksum brute-force over blocks 0-63 in FUN_0802c450/FUN_0802c5dc read-verify path shows no additive checksum (read-back compare only).
fields.name: header_word1

fields.description: First 40-entry unlock bitfield (EEPROM block 1, 8 bytes). FUN_0802252c packs 40 one-byte flags into bits and FUN_08022488 unpacks them via per-bit queries; FUN_08022d40 seeds the defaults. Baseline low word is zero mask, high word holds set bits 0xF101F1BB.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802252c packs flags 0..39 with func_0x08032a08(1,0,uVar1) into save blocks 1-2 via FUN_08021e90(1,buf,2); FUN_08022488 reads them back with FUN_08021f80(1,buf,2) and func_0x08032ab4 per-bit tests over 0x28 entries.
fields.name: unlock_bits_a

fields.description: Second 40-entry unlock bitfield (EEPROM block 2, 8 bytes). Same pack/unpack pair as unlock_bits_a, covering flag entries 40..79. Baseline high word 0x1BC3DA37 shows several bits set.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802252c second loop packs param_1[0x28..0x4F] into the second 8-byte half written by FUN_08021e90(1,buf,2); FUN_08022488 second loop unpacks via FUN_08021f80(1,buf,2) over 0x28 entries.
fields.name: unlock_bits_b

fields.description: Career slot 0 draft index (EEPROM block 3 high word): random roster pick 0..39 stored shifted left 26 by FUN_08022d40. Baseline 0x44000000 >> 26 = 17.
fields.evidence: FUN_08022d40 writes FUN_0801e360() << 0x1A into block uVar4+3 (3 when selector is 0) via FUN_08021e90; FUN_0801e360 rejects values > 0x27 (39).
